observations.body: Jesus recalls the earlier mission without lack, now directs purse and bag, speaks of buying a sword, quotes being numbered with transgressors, and ends the disciples’ report of two swords.
observations.label: Earlier provision gives way to purse, bag, sword, and fulfillment
